description:
Junpei Kousaka is a second-year high school student who despises cats and has an allergy to them. It just so happens that his high school crush is Kaede Mizuno, a girl who adores cats. One day, while walking home from school, Junpei kicks an empty can and unfortunately beans the local neko-jizou-sama (guardian deity of cats). He finds he can now understand what cats are saying, including his family's own ill-tempered cat, Nyamusas. However, if he does not grant 100 wishes from cats, he will turn into a cat himself.

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

The main protagonist with a chronic allergy to cats. He lives with his mother and sister who love cats but do not help at all with his problem. To complicate matters, one day he accidentally destroys the statue of a cat deity, and to compensate for it, he must make use of his new-found ability of communicating with cats to fulfill one hundred requests of help from them, otherwise he will be transformed into a cat!

Height: 165 cm

Junpei's classmate and crush who is totally oblivious of his feelings for her (though she realizes feelings for him as time passes). Despite loving cats, her family owns four dogs (all of which are military breeds i.e. Bernese, Lab, Husky, and Shepherd) and thus cats tend to avoid her as she always carries their smell.

__Height:__ 167 cm

Junpei Kousaka's childhood friend, until a misunderstanding happened over a friendship doll she made for him, she had believed he gave it away. However, he was just showing it around. After this incident, she had a strong rivalry with Junpei, and her sense of style changed (she wore abnormally dark make-up) but in the end, after a cat asked Junpei to thank the girl who had cared for him she went back to having a friendly relationship... Sort of. A running gag is the fact that she treats him like a slave, making him buy her cosmetics and such.

"Nabeshin" is the well-known nickname of anime director, Shinichi Watanabe. Watanabe himself is notorious for inserting himself into anime using his character, Nabeshin. He is the Deus Ex Machina of Excel Saga and a main character in Puni Puni Poemi, and while he does not appear explicitly in Nerima Daikon Brothers, it is almost universally known that the "rental guy" character is one of Nabeshin's incarnations as he, like all of Nabeshin's roles, is voiced by Brett Weaver in the English dub.  Additionally, he made a brief appearance in episode 24 of Yamato Nadeshiko Shichi Henge, and he is also the narrator in "The Road to Becoming a Lady" of the same series. Nabeshin also appears in episode 32 of Hayate the Combat Butler, and has a 1-frame appearance as a mechanic in Eyeshield 21, episode 16. In SKET Dance he had an appearance in episode 8 as a dub director.

A small cat owned by the monk in charge of the temple whose statue was broken by Junpei, and an acquaintance of Nyamsus who also brings requests to him. He goes about the neighborhood and tells the other cats around about Junpei, which is part of the reason why the local cats know so much about him. He is an extremely rare male calico cat.

__Height:__ 180 cm

Kaede's senior on the track team and heir of a powerful Yakuza family. Despite being a girl, she started assuming a more masculine behavior after she was rejected by her first love, who mistakenly assumed she was a guy because of her boyish appearance. However, after Junpei comforts her, she fell for him and resorts to extremes to be beside him, like moving to his class despite having already taken it previously. She is extremely afraid of thunder and lightning, which stems from the fact that she was traumatized from seeing Jii getting struck by lightning on several occasions.

The Kousaka family's cat. She generally plays the role of Junpei's guide throughout the show. She is the one who usually informs Junpei of the plight of cats nearby so that Junpei may help them. Nymasus is usually accompanied by Tama, another cat.
She is a college student who works part time as a mail woman. She has a very bad sense of direction and gets lost all the time as a result.
She's the most cheerful and energetic member of the Kosaka family, and Junpei's younger sister. She loves cats, and makes fun of Junpei for having a cat allergy.

__Height:__ 163 cm

She is the twin sister of Akari and the older of the two. Despite her gentle and sweet behavior, she is a bit sadistic, delusional, and an obsessive stalker. She has a crush on Junpei mainly because of his misfortunes and shows jealousy if another girl gets too close to Junpei. Only Kotone and her sister Akari know that Junpei is cursed.

__Height:__ 163 cm

She is the twin sister of Kotone and the younger of the two. Akari has an ill attitude toward Junpei in the beginning because of her sister's crush on him. This changes when she herself has a crush on Junpei. Akari has the ability to sense supernatural activity which is seen when she tells Junpei that she can see spirits and knows he was cursed. Only Akari and her sister Kotone know that Junpei is cursed.
One of Junpei's friends from Elementary School. He is in the same class as Junpei too.
He is the Buddhist monk in the temple wherein the cat deity dwells. He is the father of Kotone and Akari. He often goes to cabaret clubs despite being a monk

A black cat owned by the Kirishima twins. She received less attention (from Keizou) once Tama was adopted into the family, and was jealous of his near-royal treatment as a rare breed. Still, the two share a fondness for one another, but easily become argumentative.

Josephine is a cat owned by Nagi. He is dressed up in an elegant manner, and speaks in a Kansai dialect. He wishes for Nagi to shed her masculine behavior, and thus asks Junpei to help her fall in love once more.
One of Junpei's friends from Elementary School.
